summary: Ralliant Corp filed an 8-K on May 12, 2026, disclosing entry into an accelerated share repurchase (ASR) program to repurchase $100 million of its common stock under a pre-existing Board-authorized buyback. The repurchase price is based on the average daily Rule 10b-18 volume-weighted average price during the program term, with settlement expected by end of Q2 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The ASR is a cash-settled structure reducing share count. Watch for final settlement shares repurchased and any impact on EPS; no arbitrage angle exists as this is an issuer capital return.
